item.title: [SwiftHFR] Lists, compact density: headers align with rows in landscape (#832)
item.body:
Closes #832

Claim: mac/M1

Author model: sonnet-5.5 (mac/M1-i832-sonnet)
Reviewer model: opus-5.5 (mac/M1-r1086-opus: REQUEST CHANGES on e60ba7b8; APPROVE on cbd99a8e, the head)

### Problem
Compact density, iPhone in landscape (side safe area): the section header text does not line up with the row text.

### Cause
Measured with a hosted probe (a list as the window's root, `additionalSafeAreaInsets` left 62 as the notch inset; 932x430 and 874x402):
- `contentMargins(.horizontal, 10, for: .scrollContent)` replaces the system's whole side inset, safe area included (regular: card at x = 82 = 62 + 20; compact before the fix: card at x = 10, under the notch), while the rows keep the safe area inside the card: row text 59 pt from the card instead of 7.
- `densityCardEdge` added `safeLeading` to the list frame's x, but the frame already starts past the safe area (x = 62): the header target was 134 instead of 72 and the header's 20 pt cap kept it at 92 pt from the card.
- Right side: the card also sat under a right-side inset (notch, Duo cover) at every revision, since the 10 pt margin replaced the trailing safe inset too (header and row text looked aligned because the leading inset is 0 there).

Evidence (offset from the card edge, expected 7 / 7; header, row):
| Code | 932x430, notch left | 874x402, notch left | 874x402, both sides |
|---|---|---|---|
| before #1048 (`1df2121a^`) | 69, 59 | 69, 59 | 69, 59 |
| head `74d863c1` (with #1048) | 92, 59 | 92, 59 | 88, 59 |
| this PR | 7, 7 | 7, 7 | 7, 7 |
So #1048 did not change the landscape case (it fixed the iPad/pushed-screen one); this was a separate defect. Notch on the right only: 7, 7 at every revision.

### Change
`DensityListMargins` (`App/SwiftHFR/Settings/ListDensity.swift`): leading and trailing scroll content margins add the measured safe inset (`safeAreaInsets.leading` / `.trailing`, so RTL follows; the trailing one is what keeps the card out of a right-side notch), and `densityCardEdge` is the frame's x plus the margin. Regular density is untouched (nil margins).
No wider: the header cap and `DensityHeaderMargin` are unchanged.

### Tests
`ListDensityMarginsTests.compactHeadersAlignInLandscape(size:regularClass:safeArea:)`, 6 cases (932x430 regular width, 874x402 compact width; insets left, right, both, right 84 = Duo cover): header and row 7 pt from the card (the cell's window frame) and the window gap right of the card = 10 + right inset. Round 1: the right-edge check fails (4 cases) with `+ safeTrailing` dropped, passes with it. `SectionProbe` now hosts the list as the root when nothing precedes it, so it extends under the side safe area as a screen's list does (an HStack parent put it inside the inset, where it read no inset); the `leading:` case keeps the HStack.
- Fails without the change: 6 issues (3 of the 5 cases, header and row), numbers in the table above; the existing portrait and iPad cases pass.
- Whole `SwiftHFRTests` target: 1917 tests, 246 suites, passed (xb.sh, iPhone 18 Pro iOS 27.0).

### Device check (operator, landscape)
Compact on and off, Favoris / Messages / Search / Settings lists, notch on the left and on the right (rotate both ways): card edge keeps about 10 pt from the safe-area edge on both sides (card edge out of the notch on the right too), header text and row text on one vertical line, nothing under the notch; LTR (RTL if a device is set). The probe sets the safe area with `additionalSafeAreaInsets`, not a real notch: unverified on a device.

**Adversarial review (opus-5.5, mac/M1-r1086-opus, e60ba7b8)**: REQUEST CHANGES

The cause analysis holds: I measured both causes. The leading fix is correct and tested. The trailing half of the fix is not tested.

1. **Medium**, `App/SwiftHFR/Settings/ListDensity.swift:118` (`$0 + safeTrailing`) and `App/SwiftHFRTests/Settings/ListDensityMarginsTests.swift:201-217`. The tests only measure x from the card's **left** edge. Mutation: I dropped `+ safeTrailing` and the whole PR suite stayed green. Failing scenario: compact density, notch on the right (or the Duo cover's 84 pt right inset). Without the trailing term, the card's right edge sits 10 pt from the screen edge, under the notch, and no test catches it. At base this was already the case: the gap was 10, where 72 or 94 is expected. Fix: in the landscape test, also check the cell's window `maxX` (`width − maxX == 10 + right`). I checked such a probe: it passes at head and fails without the term (right 62 → gap 10; right 84 → gap 10).
2. **Detail**, PR body, Cause section. "Right-side notch only: aligned already" is true for text alignment, but the card was under the right notch at every revision. The trailing margin fixes that too. Say so in Cause and Change, and add "card edge out of the notch on the right" to the device check.
3. **Detail**, `ListDensity.swift:26`. The `outerMargin` doc says "screen edge to card". It is now the distance from the safe-area edge to the card.

Checked and fine:
- **Feedback loop (#979):** none. Content margins do not move the list frame or its safe-area insets, and the probes converge.
- **#1048 cases:** `leading: 100` and portrait still pass.
- **iPad columns:** away from the screen edge, the safe inset is 0, so the behaviour is unchanged.
- **RTL:** `.leading`/`.trailing` margins match `safeAreaInsets.leading`/`.trailing`.
- **Regular density:** untouched (nil margins).
- **`SectionProbe` root change:** it does not weaken the portrait cases (zero insets either way).
- **Lint:** no added line over 140 characters. The function and type bodies stay small.
- **Ledger:** none needed. This is the #799 deliberate gap, and no legacy behaviour changes.

**Verified** (disposable worktree at e60ba7b8, simulator 9AAF4FFD, via xb.sh, `ListDensityMarginsTests` only):
- Head: 10/10 pass, including my trailing probe for right insets 0, 62 and 84.
- Mutation, whole fix reverted (`ListDensity.swift` from dev-swift): 6 landscape issues, plus my probe fails.
- Mutation, margins kept but the old `+ safeLeading` card edge restored: 3 header issues.
- Mutation, `+ safeTrailing` dropped: the PR's tests stay green and only my probe fails (finding 1).
- Not run: the full `SwiftHFRTests` target and a real device.

**Adversarial review (opus-5.5, mac/M1-r1086-opus, delta cbd99a8e)**: APPROVE

All three findings from e60ba7b8 are fixed:

1. **Fixed: the right edge is now tested.** `compactHeadersAlignInLandscape` (`ListDensityMarginsTests.swift:205-223`) checks `rightGap == 10 + safeArea.right` and adds a Duo-cover case (right inset 84). With `+ safeTrailing` dropped, the four cases with a right inset (62, 62, 62+62, 84) fail. The two left-only cases pass, as they should.
2. **Fixed: PR body.** The Cause section now says the card sat under a right-side inset at every revision. The Change section ties the trailing margin to that. The device check now includes "card edge out of the notch on the right too".
3. **Fixed: `outerMargin` doc** (`ListDensity.swift:26`). It now says "safe-area edge to the card". The new lines are under 140 characters.

Detail, no change needed: the evidence table still says "Notch on the right only: 7, 7 at every revision". That is about text alignment, and the new Cause bullet covers the card's position.

**Verified**: disposable worktree at cbd99a8e, simulator 9AAF4FFD, via xb.sh, `ListDensityMarginsTests` only.
- Head: 9/9 pass.
- Mutation with `+ safeTrailing` dropped: 4 issues, all in the landscape test.
- Not run: the full target and a real device.
